title: Epuru Sudhakar v. Govt. of A.P.

content.caseIdentity: Epuru Sudhakar v. Govt. of A.P., (2006) 8 SCC 161
content.holding: Pardoning orders under Articles 72 and 161 are subject to judicial review on grounds of mala fides, extraneous considerations, non-application of mind, or political/caste bias.
content.relevance: Established grounds of judicial review of pardoning power.

evidence.note: 2-Judge Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Crl.) No. 79 of 2005; 2006 INSC 712; (2006) 8 SCC 161.
